title: Illumina Debuts BioInsight Platform Unifying AI, Software, and Data
key_facts: Illumina launched the BioInsight Platform on 14 Oct 2026, described as its first unified software environment for genomic and multiomic data.
It brings analysis applications, purpose-built AI models and curated data behind one sign-on, including the SpliceAI2 model for rare disease announced 8 Oct.
Includes DRAGEN v4.6 analysis software with a mode for cloud and standard CPU environments.
DRAGEN supports about 170 research projects of the Global Parkinson's Genetics Program.
A usage-based credits model replaces annual subscriptions, and a free trial is offered.
The BioInsight business unit was formed 1 Oct 2025; Illumina shows the platform at ASHG in Montreal on 20-24 Oct 2026.
quote_evidence: Illumina on October 14, 2026 debuted the Illumina BioInsight Platform, which the company describes as its first unified software environment for turning complex genomic and multiomic data into meaningful biological evidence.
A usage-based BioInsight Credits model replaces traditional annual subscriptions
why_it_matters_hint: Puts genomic AI tools and data in one place for researchers, but it is a product launch described by the company.
notes: Article rests on Illumina's announcement; the Unite.AI piece carries an AI-generated byline reviewed by its editors.
